incidents.summary: A corporate subsidiary contaminated Ontario's Wabigoon River with mercury between 1962 and 1970, and the Grassy Narrows First Nation chief reported that it remained highly contaminated in 2017.

sources.title: RELX
sources.quote: The mercury contamination of the Wabigoon River in Ontario Canada by a corporate subsidiary between 1962 and 1970 was "one of the worst cases of environmental poisoning in Canadian history."

sources.title: RELX
sources.quote: As of 2017, Grassy Narrows First Nation chief Simon Fobister stated that the river remained highly contaminated.

incidents.summary: A class action alleged unauthorized use of personal information to advertise LexisNexis products; in February 2025, the court dismissed the foreign parent companies for lack of personal jurisdiction.

sources.title: LexisNexis Hit With Privacy Class Action Over Alleged Use of PII to 'Turn a Profit' | Law.com
sources.quote: The complaint alleges that the companies disclosed "trove[s] of personally identifiable information of millions of Americans to advertise their Lexis Personal Records Products" without authorization, violating the California Right of Publicity Act and Illinois Right of Publicity Act.

sources.title: Court Dismisses LexisNexis Parents From Right-of-Publicity Suit
sources.quote: The US District Court for the District of California lacked personal jurisdiction over RELX PLC, RELX Group PLC, RELX (Holdings) Ltd., and RELX Overseas Holdings Ltd. because they didn’t have the required minimum contacts with California, Judge Dale S. Fischer said Feb. 14.

sources.title: Court Dismisses LexisNexis Parents From Right-of-Publicity Suit
sources.quote: Megan Trama and three other plaintiffs alleged RELX Inc., the US operator of the LexisNexis personal records products, used consumers’ ...

incidents.summary: A Seisint security breach exposed at least 316,000 people's records, and Reed Elsevier settled an FTC action over security failures in 2008 with a requirement to establish a comprehensive security program.

sources.title: RELX
sources.quote: In 2005, a security breach occurred through a recently purchased subsidiary, Seisint, which allowed identity thieves to steal the records of at least 316,000 people.

sources.title: RELX
sources.quote: In 2008 the company settled an action taken against it by the Federal Trade Commission for multiple failures of security practice in how the data was stored and protected.

sources.title: RELX
sources.quote: The settlement required Reed Elsevier and Seisint to establish and maintain a comprehensive security program to protect nonpublic personal information.

incidents.summary: A California plaintiff sued RELX Inc., alleging that its Lex Machina website deployed tracking software without users' prior consent in violation of the California Invasion of Privacy Act.

sources.title: LexisNexis Parent Company Latest to Be Hit With CIPA Lawsuit Over Web Tracking Software | Law.com
sources.quote: California resident and serial plaintiff Jerry Aviles has sued RELX Inc., the parent company of LexisNexis and Lex Machina, alleging that it deployed web tracking software on its Lex Machina website without users' prior consent, in violation of the California Invasion of Privacy Act (CIPA).

incidents.summary: Reed Elsevier faced a campaign over its defence exhibitions, including a reported offering of cluster bombs at a subsidiary's event, and announced in June 2007 that it would exit the business.

sources.title: RELX
sources.quote: Between 2005 and 2007, members of the medical and scientific communities, which purchase and use many journals published by Reed Elsevier, agitated for the company to cut its links to the arms trade.

sources.title: RELX
sources.quote: A subsidiary, Spearhead, organised defence shows, including an event where it was reported that cluster bombs and extremely powerful riot control equipment were offered for sale.

sources.title: RELX
sources.quote: Subsequently, in June the company announced that they would be exiting the defence exhibition business during the second half of the year.

incidents.summary: UCS and SGR petitioned Elsevier and RELX to align their activities with climate commitments, and SGR said in September 2023 that the company's response failed to address activities enabling high emitters.

sources.title: Science Groups Launch Petition Urging Journal Publisher to Share Plan for Halting Anti-Climate Practices | Union of Concerned Scientists
sources.quote: The Union of Concerned Scientists (UCS) and Scientists for Global Responsibility today launched a petition requesting a formal response from Elsevier and its parent company RELX that outlines how they intend to meet their commitments as a member of the U.N. Race to Zero campaign.

sources.title: Science Groups Launch Petition Urging Journal Publisher to Share Plan for Halting Anti-Climate Practices | Union of Concerned Scientists
sources.quote: Hosting coal, offshore drilling, and other industry exhibitions that enable participants to grow their businesses and boost fossil fuel production.

sources.title: Elsevier is still enabling high-carbon emitters | SGR: Responsible Science
sources.quote: Dr Balisciano’s response made it clear that, while RELX/Elsevier is making progress in reduce its own corporate greenhouse gas emissions, it continues to turn a blind eye to its activities that enable other entities to remain high emitters.

incidents.summary: A former Cell Press employee and RELX shareholder filed a lawsuit alleging retaliation for raising greenwashing concerns and misleading statements to investors about the company's climate commitments.

sources.title: Publishing and Data-Analytics Firm Hit With “Greenwashing” Securities Suit | The D&O Diary
sources.quote: He also alleges that the company misled investors about the company’s climate commitments and its climate-related actions.

sources.title: Publishing and Data-Analytics Firm Hit With “Greenwashing” Securities Suit | The D&O Diary
sources.quote: Lyall says he decided to speak up regarding his climate-related concerns, but that rather than discussing his concerns, the company “intimidated and harassed him,” and in August 2023, terminated him, allegedly for speaking out.

sources.title: Publishing and Data-Analytics Firm Hit With “Greenwashing” Securities Suit | The D&O Diary
sources.quote: A copy of the August 6, 2024, complaint can be found here.

positives: RELX received recognition in Sustainability Magazine's 2025 sustainable-company ranking.

incidents.summary: The NUJ condemned LexisNexis and LexisNexis Risk Solutions' notified intention to terminate longstanding union recognition agreements and urged reversal.

sources.title: NUJ condemns RELX for its union-busting decision to derecognise the union at LexisNexis and LexisNexis Risk Solutions
sources.quote: The National Union of Journalists (NUJ) has today received notification from LexisNexis and LexisNexis Risk Solutions (formerly RBI) of its intention to terminate long-standing recognition agreements with the union.

sources.title: NUJ condemns RELX for its union-busting decision to derecognise the union at LexisNexis and LexisNexis Risk Solutions
sources.quote: The NUJ strongly condemns the decision, urging a reversal of the ill-judged attempt to remove collective bargaining rights from journalists and editorial workers.
